verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for an error-tracking service, so the axis applies. The pack only says GlitchTip "aims to be Sentry API compatible" and has release notes flagging "breaking changes"; neither documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
